headline: Three Singapore Palm Oil Firms Agree to Engage Assessors in Haze Probe
summary: TSH Resources, Bumitama Agri, and Kencana Agri have agreed to engage and cooperate with assessors investigating transboundary haze pollution.
why: Environmental regulatory compliance and investigations into plantation practices carry financial and operational risks for Southeast Asian agribusinesses.
